Refer to the following letter, symbol series and answer the question.

R # A $ G H K % T B M & N Y ÷ X B / L Q @ D

If the second symbol and third letter from the left end of series are combined with the fifth and six terms from the right end of the series, then what letter symbol combination will be formed?
questions.solution:
(Left) R # A $ G H K % T B M & N Y ÷ X B / L Q @ D (Right)

1) Second symbol and third letter from the left end 

R # A __**$**__ __**G**__ H K % T B M & N Y ÷ X B / L Q 

In the above series second symbol and third letter is** $ G**** **

2) The fifth and six terms from the right end

R # A $ G H K % T B M & N Y ÷ X **__B__ __/__ **L Q @ D

In the above series the fifth and six terms from the right end is **B /**

If The second symbol and third letter from the left end of series are combined with the fifth and six terms from the right end of the series, then we get $ G / B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"$ G / B".**

questions.question: Five friends L, M, N, O, P, each has a different height. L is shorter than M but taller than N. O is shorter than N. P is taller than O. M is taller than P. Who among them is the tallest?
questions.solution:
Five friends L, M, N, O, P, each has a different height.

1) L is shorter than M but taller than N.

→** M > L > N > _ > _**

2) O is shorter than N. P is taller than O.

→ M > L > N > P **> O**

3) M is taller than P.

**→ M > L > N > P > O**

Therefore, the final order of five friends as per as their heights is as follows:

→ **M > L > N > P > O**

From the above arrangement, it is clear that among all the five friends M is the tallest one.

Hence, the correct answer is **"M".**

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E and W live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on, till the topmost floor is numbered 6. No one lives below D. Only two people live between E and W. Only two people live between C and A. Only one person lives between D and A. E lives on some floor above A. How many people live below B?
questions.solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, and W live on six different floors of the same building numbered from 1 (lowest) to 6 (highest).

1) No one lives below D → D lives on Floor 1.

2) Only one person lives between D and A → A must be on Floor 3 (since D is on 1).

3) E lives on some floor above A → E must be on Floor 4, 5, or 6.

4) Only two people live between C and A → C can be on Floor 6 or Floor 1, but Floor 1 is occupied by D, so C must be on Floor 6.

5) Only two people live between E and W → If E is on Floor 5, W can be on 2 or 2 floors below (not possible since 2 is the only option).
